story.storyContextArabic: تسأل إيلي ليث إن كانت الاستراحة ساعدته على العودة للعمل بهدوء.

allowedForeshadowing: تفصيل صغير غير مفسر عند الحاجة.

lines.narrationArabic: تسأل إيلي ليث إن كانت الاستراحة ساعدته على العودة للعمل بهدوء.

scenes.purposeArabic: التحدث عن ما فعلته خلال الاستراحة وتأثيره.

lines.targetText: Buongiorno, Laith. Hai riposato bene ieri?
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Laith. Did you rest well yesterday?
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير يا ليث. Did you rest well yesterday?
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno, Laith. Hai riposato bene ieri?

lines.targetText: Buongiorno. Sì, mi sono preso una pausa e mi sono sentito meglio.
lines.englishReference: Good morning. Yes, I took a break and felt better.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. Yes, I took a break and felt better.
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno. Sì, mi sono preso una pausa e mi sono sentito meglio.

lines.targetText: Cosa hai fatto durante la pausa?
lines.englishReference: What did you do during your break?
lines.arabicTranslation: What did you do during your break?
lines.pronunciation: Cosa hai fatto durante la pausa?

lines.targetText: Ho camminato vicino al fiume e ho ascoltato gli uccelli.
lines.englishReference: I walked near the river and listened to the birds.
lines.arabicTranslation: I walked near the river and listened to the birds.
lines.pronunciation: Ho camminato vicino al fiume e ho ascoltato gli uccelli.

lines.targetText: Sei pronto a lavorare di nuovo?
lines.englishReference: Are you ready to work again?
lines.arabicTranslation: Are you ready to work again?
lines.pronunciation: Sei pronto a lavorare di nuovo?

lines.englishReference: That sounds like a good plan.

scenes.promptArabic: انقل مهارة اليوم إلى حياتك: الحديث عن التعافي بعد ضغط.

scenes.purposeArabic: استماع جانبي طبيعي بلا كشف مبكر.

lines.targetText: Il mercato sta cambiando rapidamente in questa stagione.
lines.englishReference: The market is changing quickly this season.
lines.pronunciation: Il mercato sta cambiando rapidamente in questa stagione.

lines.targetText: SÌ. Le persone fanno più domande sulle vecchie strade.
lines.englishReference: Yes. People are asking more questions about old roads.
lines.arabicTranslation: نعم. الناس يسألون أكثر عن الطرق القديمة.
lines.pronunciation: SÌ. Le persone fanno più domande sulle vecchie strade.

scenes.setupArabic: تظهر مهمة حقيقية في سياق: راحة مفيدة.
